description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP WiFi Message Bus Service, including function declarations for message bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource management, signal sending, and message handling within the CCSP framework.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus component with provided identifiers and configuration.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi MBI with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources for the WiFi MBI.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check or validation on the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Releases resources with a specified priority.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Signals that a transfer operation has completed.

methods.name: CcspPandM_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages for the specified path.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the service to the Controller or Registry with parameter array.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Checks if a specific condition or component is ready via message bus handle and component identifiers.
